game_title: Off By One Fixer – Druid Grove Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mystic Forest – Druid Grove, the druids' grove: the forest ranger must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Druid Grove: the druids' grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Druid Grove, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about fixes to power up the forest ranger and open the herb garden.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Off By One Fixer
